run_sentence_transformer_nli_training: run sentence transformer NLI training on AllNLI dataset using Gaudi hardware with GISTEmbedLoss
train_sentence_transformer_gaudi: train a sentence transformer model on the AllNLI triplet dataset with a guiding model on Habana Gaudi
